parent_lab.unblock_reason: Coin Metrics Community API documents server-side start_time/end_time bounds and exposes native-unit total fees and current ETH supply without API key. This avoids the prior full-history protected-year problem.

literature_anchor.title: Demand-Side Fee Flows and Return Predictability on Ethereum

public_methodology.flow_intensity: daily total network fees / circulating ETH supply

source.license_note: Community data is documented as free for non-commercial use under a Creative Commons license.

metric_semantics.FeeTotNtv: Total fees in native units. Coin Metrics documents that for Ethereum it includes transaction base fees, priority fees and blob fees after Dencun.
metric_semantics.SplyCur: Current ETH supply in native units.

outcome_boundary: No market price is requested during the source gate.
No returns, PnL, regression outcome, direction accuracy or trading result is computed during the source gate.
No 2025 or 2026 source observation may be requested.
No live trading, exchange mutation, wallet use or merge to main.
